topic: Optimizing satellite link budgets for high throughput and low latency in global aeronautical coverage
consensus_response: The integration of AI/ML into the path selection mechanism can enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of satellite link budgets, ensuring high throughput and low latency in global aeronautical coverage. This can drive innovation, improve operational efficiency, and enable more reliable and autonomous systems. The aerospace industry will benefit from more efficient and reliable satellite communication, leading to safer and more effective operations in a wide range of applications.
reference_context: The discussion highlights the importance of addressing technical challenges such as managing varying link conditions, mitigating high fixed latencies, and developing effective path selection mechanisms. The integration of AI/ML can improve the accuracy and reliability of the AI/ML models, ensuring they perform well under varying conditions.
